info.title: Models Router Service API
info.description: Supplier-neutral model metadata is additive on capability profiles. Requests still select only the frozen capabilityRef/version; native model IDs and execution configuration stay server-owned. Independent model/Agent infrastructure protocol for multiple products. Optional promptSpec is a separately versioned normalized instruction/message/conditioning/output-requirement envelope; frozen capability profiles and parameter schemas remain unchanged. Default unconfigured mode keeps an empty capability catalogue and honest 501 execution responses. Explicit ROUTER_ADAPTER_MODE=mock enables 20 clearly labeled test capabilities and durable fixture-only invocations/events/artifacts; all carry testMode=true, and usage/context/billing stay null. MOCK promptSpec acceptance is envelope-only; actual instruction/conditioning execution and schema-constrained generation remain RESERVED with real inference/Agent runtime and tool receipts. Legacy RESERVED schema examples describe future semantics, not executions. Product history stays in each product; Router owns actor scope, logical sessions and invocation receipts. No native thread IDs or upstream credentials cross this contract.

x-actor-proof.signingKeyEncoding: Secret configuration uses standard padded base64; decoded key length >=32 bytes. Separate from service bearer token.
x-actor-proof.canonicalEncoding: UTF-8; fields joined by LF; no extra trailing LF (empty final Idempotency-Key field naturally leaves the preceding separator)
canonicalFields: original escaped request target including original raw query
SHA256 of exact raw body as lowercase hex (empty body hash for GET)
x-actor-proof.duplicates: Authorization and every actor proof header must occur exactly once. Client app is bound to the verified service credential. Fresh proof nonce per HTTP retry or SSE reconnect; invocation idempotency key remains stable.
x-actor-proof.transport: TLS or a trusted private transport is required outside local development. No CORS/browser credential use; keys and canonical signed strings must never be logged.

ServiceBearer.description: Private service token, >=32 characters; uniquely bound to one allowlisted clientApp.

ActorSignature.name: X-Router-Actor-Signature
ActorSignature.description: Trusted actor proof; see x-actor-proof and pkg/actorproof.

ClientApp.name: X-Router-Client-App
ClientApp.description: Must equal the allowlisted clientApp bound to the verified service credential.

SubjectRef.name: X-Router-Subject-Ref
SubjectRef.description: Stable local owner from the product server's verified login; never taken from browser-supplied actor headers.

ActorTimestamp.name: X-Router-Actor-Timestamp
ActorTimestamp.description: Canonical decimal Unix seconds within plus or minus 300 seconds.

ActorNonce.name: X-Router-Actor-Nonce
ActorNonce.description: Fresh random nonce per HTTP attempt; at least 128 bits of cryptographic entropy. Persistently unique per serviceRef while proof remains valid.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Required for MOCK invocation acceptance. Identity is scoped by clientApp and subjectRef; either the same key or operationRef restores the existing receipt only when the normalized immutable request matches. A different immutable request is 409. Attachment readGrantRef is excluded from that hash; refreshing it does not create a job. Rotate the proof nonce per HTTP retry and reuse this key. Session and capability endpoints reject this header with 400.

CreateSessionRequest.description: Actor comes only from verified service proof. No user, clientApp or subject field is accepted here.

Session.description: Persisted logical identity survives service restart and STUDIO login changes. Native thread/session IDs never appear. Current release returns null checkpoint and runtimeMetadata.

Usage.description: Unknown counts are null, never fabricated zero. Cached/reasoning counters can be subsets of reported totals; do not add them blindly. PRIMARY_THREAD does not imply child-agent coverage.

UsageUnit.description: Optional non-token usage units for image/video/local compute. Unit count does not imply a price, and not every adapter reports every unit.

ContextUsage.description: Cumulative billing usage is not current context occupancy. remainingTokensEstimate is a best-effort estimate, not guaranteed balance; adapters preserve observation time and compaction facts.

Billing.description: Decimal strings prevent floating point price loss. Actual charge requires authoritative billing evidence. Token usage alone is not a price; unknown fields stay null.

testMode.description: Optional additive provenance flag. MOCK adapter results always set true; this is not evidence of real model execution.

parameterSchema.description: Immutable JSON Schema 2020-12 for the specific capability/version. Reject unsupported inputs explicitly.

inputKinds.description: Semantic kinds such as TEXT, IMAGE, VIDEO, AUDIO, FILE or STRUCTURED; the fixed capability schema constrains actual combinations.

supportsSession.description: Legacy session support projection. Absent sessionMode means OPTIONAL when true, otherwise NONE.

sessionMode.description: Optional additive field. NONE requires supportsSession=false; OPTIONAL/REQUIRED require true. NONE and OPTIONAL support independent requests without logical sessions.

supportsStream.description: Verified incremental output support. Persisted Router SSE state/progress events do not imply native token or media streaming.

model.description: Optional public metadata. New model selectors use configured profiles with this metadata; absence preserves existing generic and MOCK capabilities. Determine text/image eligibility from kind and inputKinds, not model titles.

CapabilityList.description: Default unconfigured mode returns items=[] and nextCursor=null. Explicit ROUTER_ADAPTER_MODE=mock registers 20 test capabilities, all titled MOCK · KIND and marked testMode=true. kind filtering precedes cursor/limit pagination. nextCursor is the next decimal offset or null when exhausted.

MockParameters.description: MOCK-only immutable parameter profile version 1. Empty {} is accepted. These parameters control test fixtures, not model generation settings. Unknown properties are rejected.

Attachment.description: Media exchange authorization is RESERVED. An asset ID or arbitrary URL is not permission. Stable source/version/digest participates in request identity; rotating short-lived readGrantRef does not.

PromptInstruction.description: Trusted text instructions compiled by the authenticated product service. Whitespace-only instructions are rejected. Total instruction UTF-8 bytes are at most 262144. No media or input references can occur in this instruction channel.

PromptMessage.description: Ordered message referencing zero-based positions in the top-level typed input. Every input position appears exactly once across all messages, and at least one USER message is required. Product history cannot carry SYSTEM/DEVELOPER roles.

PromptConditioning.description: Each reference must exist in this request's validated attachment/input set. REFERENCE_IMAGE/SKETCH/MASK/FIRST_FRAME/LAST_FRAME/POSE/DEPTH/STYLE require IMAGE; MOTION_REFERENCE/SOURCE_VIDEO require VIDEO; REFERENCE_AUDIO/VOICE require AUDIO. An optional target must be a different IMAGE or VIDEO attachment in the same request. Duplicate identical bindings are rejected. These annotations do not establish actual provider conditioning support.

oneOf.description: Declared result direction must match the capability output kinds. This is a request, not evidence of actual output conformance.

Requires a TEXT/STRUCTURED output capability. A nonempty JSON Schema document is envelope-checked (at most 65536 serialized UTF-8 bytes and 32 schema-node levels); only resolvable local JSON Pointer references are accepted. Schema keywords remain document data. Full schema validation and constrained real generation are RESERVED; MOCK does not emit claimed schema-conforming data.

PromptSpec.description: Optional separately versioned normalized prompt envelope. Template audit fields are either all absent or all supplied; their digest is product provenance, not Router proof of upstream hidden preset content. All fields, ordered roles, references and schema data participate in immutable request identity. MOCK accepts/persists the envelope without executing its semantics or changing any frozen capability parameter profile. contextSnapshot is never promoted into instructions.

contextSnapshot.description: Immutable normalized authorized context, ordered message content, tools/skills versions, media digests and checkpoint. No native thread ID, credentials or arbitrary file paths.

InvocationRequest.description: Version-1 request envelope with additive optional promptSpec in contract 1.3.0. Frozen capability versions and parameter schemas remain unchanged. sessionRef may be absent/null for independent execution unless the selected capability requires a session. Correlation and context are optional, never an implicit product conversation/thread dependency. Explicit MOCK acceptance validates and freezes the normalized request and persists its actor-scoped receipt before 202. Rotating attachment readGrantRef is excluded from immutable identity; source/version/digest and all promptSpec fields remain included. MOCK does not fetch or validate real media grants or execute prompt/schema semantics. Default unconfigured mode returns 501 ADAPTER_NOT_CONFIGURED without creating an invocation. Real adapter acceptance remains RESERVED.

Artifact.description: Temporary actor-scoped output with optional semantic kind. MOCK artifacts are labeled testMode=true with fixtureLabel and contain actual stored fixture bytes, never a fabricated supplier URL. Products import verified bytes into their own asset storage before permanent history. Real generation settings depend on the selected capability schema.

testMode.description: Optional additive provenance flag. MOCK adapter results always set true; this is not evidence of real model execution.

Invocation.description: Explicit MOCK mode persists QUEUED/RUNNING/SUCCEEDED/FAILED/CANCELED receipts with testMode=true. MOCK usage, context and billing are always null. Terminal completion/cancellation is serialized and terminal states do not change. The broader enum reserves real-runtime states; UNKNOWN requires reconciliation, never automatic retry with a new provider or key.

ToolResultRequest.description: RESERVED. Each callRef/result is scoped to a verified WAITING_TOOL invocation and must be idempotent; mismatched results return 409.

testMode.description: Optional additive provenance flag. MOCK adapter results always set true; this is not evidence of real model execution.

Event.description: Persistent monotonic per-invocation sequence, bound to the verified actor. MOCK events carry testMode=true. SSE id equals decimal sequence and data is this envelope. Event type selects its data schema. MOCK SSE replays one finite persisted page, closes, and requires a new signed request to continue; it is not native output streaming. Real verified callbacks remain RESERVED.

EventPage.description: JSON event replay page. nextCursor is the last returned sequence as a decimal string, or null when items is empty; it does not mean no later event exists. terminal reports the current invocation terminal state. Resume after the last sequence until an empty terminal page is observed.

ProgressUpdatedEvent.description: Unknown progress remains null; never synthesize a percentage from an elapsed timer.

ModelDescriptor.description: Verified, configured public model metadata for choosing capability profiles. Public refs are stable supplier-neutral product identifiers, never native provider IDs, credentials or runtime configuration. Legacy profiles may omit this optional metadata; clients must preserve frozen legacy references on existing operations.
